candidate.role: injected (real pre-existing gaps, nothing planted) + trap-stack, round 2
candidate.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes (mass assignment)
candidate.flaw_one_line: T0 (example): TransformOperationExecutor.getKeys filters plain-to-class keys by exclusion, version and group using the PLAIN key, but the key is the @Expose custom name, not the property name, so every restriction on a renamed property is skipped on input. T1 (class A, feature-absent): MetadataStorage.getStrategy reads only the class's own class-level @Exclude()/@Expose(), with no ancestor walk (every property-level lookup walks ancestors), so a whole-class exclusion on a base class is ignored for every subclass, on input and output. T2 (wrong record): findExposeMetadataByCustomName returns ancestors' metadata first while findExposeMetadata returns the subclass's own first, so a T0 fix that checks the record found by JSON name misses restrictions a subclass adds to an inherited renamed property.

traps.realistic_because: Real, unmodified upstream code; reported upstream as open bugs #95 (2018) and #1097. Base entity classes marked @Exclude() with @Expose() whitelists are the README's 'Skipping all properties of the class' pattern; TypeScript class decorators do not inherit by themselves, which is the likely dismissal reason.
